acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or jagged indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, lower-luminance secondary speckling is visible in the interstitial spaces between the primary vertical columns of high-intensity spots.
